title: Activist demands time-bound prosecution in long-pending paper leak cases relating to two NDA MLAs in U.P.
description: The cases involve long-pending paper leak issues relating to Suheldev Bharatiya Samaj Party (SBSP) MLA Bedi Ram and Nishad Party MLA Vipul Dubey, both allies of the ruling Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) in Uttar Pradesh
